title: Decentralized Stochastic Constrained Optimization via Prox-Linearization
summary: This paper studies consensus-based decentralized stochastic optimization for minimizing possibly non-convex expected objectives with convex non-smooth regularizers and nonlinear functional inequality constraints. We reformulate the constrained problem using the exact-penalty model and develop two algorithms that require only local stochastic gradients and first-order constraint information.
